basic_info.description: Attention investors, developers and owner-occupiers! Welcome to 1351-1355 Washington, a corner building with 3 vacant units in a prime Nob Hill location. The three units boast soaring ceilings, crown molding details, inviting original fireplaces, hardwood floors, and windows on all three sides for ample natural light. The top and middle unit include 3 spacious bedrooms, 1 bathroom, and in-unit washer/dryer hookups. Gorgeous views of the Bay can be enjoyed from the top unit. There are  panoramic views from the accessible roof space. The lower unit offers a 2-room studio layout for potential residents. Between its amazing location along the cable cars, MUNI, and the plethora of Polk St restaurants & bars and its versatile layout with income potential, the possibilities are endless on Washington Street!
